description: User Datagram Protocol FSM definition with a single state.

transitions.documentation: Triggered when the application sends data. It creates a datagram with origin/destination ports, length, and checksum, then sends it down the simulated channel.
Triggered when a datagram arrives and the 16-bit 1s complement checksum is valid. Delivers data up to the application layer.
Triggered when a datagram arrives but the checksum validation fails. Discards the segment silently without notifying the sender.
